const data: Record<number, number> = {};
const numericText: Record<'1', number> = data;
const textualData: Record<string, number> = {};
const numericKey: Record<2, number> = textualData;

class NeverReturns {
  get value() {
    while (false) return 1;
  }
}
const getter = {
  get value() {
    if (false) return 1;
  },
};

function shadowObject() {
  interface Object { label: string }
  const object: Object = 3;
  console.log(object.label);
}

abstract class Contract {
  abstract value: number = 1;
}
